findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 7 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 72 questions numbered 1-72; by section: 7.1 7, 7.2 4, 7.2.1 4, 7.2.2 4, 7.2.3 7, 7.3 2, 7.3.1 1, 7.3.2 3, 7.3.3 7, 7.4.1 4, 7.4.2 3, 7.4.3 6, 7.4.4 4, 7.5.1 4, 7.5.2 4, 7.6 8.

Covers sections 7.1-7.6 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use values changed from the book's examples and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise (rate definition, half-life meaning, order vs molecularity, Ea vs ΔH are left to the exercise). Book corrections followed: tangent for instantaneous rate, products formed at half the HI rate, CH₃COOC₂H₅, rate = k[H₂O₂][I⁻], first-order k in s⁻¹, Table 7.3 third rate 0.075.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
